query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, me hearties! Gather close and lend yer ears!

Beyond that black horizon lies a treasure the sea herself has tried to hide — gold enough to make kings bow, jewels bright enough to shame the stars, and glory that’ll be sung in every port from here to Tortuga!

But treasure don’t reveal itself to cowards. It waits for the bold, the clever, and the stubborn souls who’ll dig through sand, storm, and legend to claim what others were too afraid to seek.

So raise the sails, sharpen yer wits, and keep yer eyes keener than a gull’s! Every mark on the map, every whisper in the wind, every strange stone and crooked tree may lead us closer.

Today we hunt not just for gold — we hunt for our names to be carved into the bones of history!

Now move, ye scallywags! Treasure waits for no crew! Arrr!
